source.name: Pressure
source.originalDescription: When Mewtwo deals damage to enemy players with a basic attack, the Mega gauge increases up to 12 times. As the Mega gauge increases, Mewtwo's Sp. Atk is increased by 1.5%, and attack speed is increased by 3%, up to 10 times. If Mewtwo is level 5 or higher, and the Mega gauge has increased at least 12 times, Mewtwo Mega Evolves. The Mega Evolution lasts 10s and increases Sp. Atk by an additional 10%, attack speed by an additional 35%, max HP by 10%, and movement speed by 5%. Consumes up to 30 Aeos Energy upon Mega Evolving. Mega Evolution duration is extended by 1 second for every 5 energy consumed. Energy is consumed regardless if you have the next multiple of 5. The Mega gauge does not deplete upon being KO'd.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Pressure は 通常攻撃速度を上げる、攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる、KOまたはアシストで発動する。

source.name: Infinite Psyburn
source.originalDescription: Mewtwo becomes unstoppable while revealing enemy players and channeling a powerful attack on the enemies' current position. After 1s, Mewtwo brings down a powerful psychic beam on their original position, dealing damage to enemies around each point of impact, leaving them unable to act for 0.6s and decreasing their Sp. Defense by 15% for 3s. Each Pokémon can only be hit by 1 psychic beam. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Infinite Psyburn は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、防御・特防を変化させる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、遅延または時間差でダメージを与える。
